n: ὁ κύριος (ho kurios) 'the Lord' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Ὥστε (Hōste) 'so that' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of Ἴστε, (Iste) 'You should know' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἐν ὑμῖν (en humin) 'among you' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
νεκρά (nekra) 'dead' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἀργή (argē) 'worthless' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
τοίνυν (toinun) 'therefore' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Εἰ (Ei) 'If' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἰδού (idou) 'behold' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR ¦ Ἴδε (o=Ide) behold - G2396=INJ in: Byz) instead of δὲ (de) 'now' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
θεὸν (theon) 'God' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of κύριον (kurion) 'Lord' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
πηγὴ (pēgē) 'spring' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
μοιχοὶ καὶ (moichoi kai) 'adulterers — and' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
καὶ κριτὴς (kai kritēs) 'and Judge' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἕτερον (heteron) 'another' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of πλησίον;¶ (plēsion) 'neighbour?' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἕνα (hena) 'one' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἐστιν (estin) 'it is' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR ¦ ἔσται (o=estai) it will be - G1510=V-FDI-3S in: Byz) instead of ἐστε (este) 'you are' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ὡς (hōs) 'as' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
κατακριθῆτε (katakrithēte) 'you may be condemned' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR) instead of κριθῆτε· (krithēte) 'you may be judged;' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
μου, (mou) 'of mine' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ὑπὸκρίσιν (hupokrisin) 'hypocrisy' occurs in a few manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of κρίσιν (krisin) 'judgment' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+KJV)
οὖν (oun) 'therefore' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
μου, (mou) 'of Mine,' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
γινώσκετε (ginōskete) 'do know' occurs in a few manuscripts (WH) instead of γινωσκέτω (ginōsketō) 'he should know' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+Treg+TR+Byz)
